C9000211.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 211 (The geometric phase diagram, diffusion, and spectra of random planar maps.; papers: Random Walks on Critical FK–Ising Maps and Liouville Brownian Motion; Spectral convergence for critical FK–Ising planar maps; A Linear Clock for Random Walk on Tree-Weighted Planar Maps; Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps; The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4; Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps; Brownian continuum random tree limits of finite Fortuin–Kasteleyn maps above four; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/211.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_GREEN_BOUND.statement: The original gr:green-bound for every 0<rho<1/2, in the exact uniform finite rooted map/tree ensemble and with a map-measurable coefficient simultaneous over all centered bounded sources.

C_GREEN_ESTIMATE.statement: All-size strengthening: uniform L^p Green constants for 1<p<3 and rho<1-1/p; also an expected-uniform critical 2/3 source modulus with logarithmic power beta>4/3. Independent mathematical, citation, and novelty review pending.

L_GREEN_ENCODING.statement: Explicit forward and inverse finite encoding, exact primal and dual incidence permutations, and b=1+dual-distance preserve vertical Dyck independence after smaller-side selection, including ties. No unproved companion encoding theorem is used.

L_GREEN_CONTOUR.statement: Uniform contour inverse-distance L^p moments for p<3, quantitative growth at most C(3-p)^(-1/p) for 2<=p<3, and an L^4 local-diameter bound.

L_GREEN_SCALE.statement: The one-scale reciprocal-cut sum has a uniform L^p bound for 1<p<3; only schedule-dependent exceptions are conditioned on.

L_GREEN_TRANSFER.statement: Universal deterministic transport from pointwise cut bounds to one source-independent averaged coefficient for all admissible sources; separate positive-mass smaller-side lemma.
